hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Understand how to preserve your expiring points and redirect them safely toward your long-term goals.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer has 2,400 points expiring in 9 days while maintaining multiple long-horizon savings goals.
hypotheses.storyTension: Risk of losing accumulated value through inaction versus aversion to high-pressure, manipulative urgency tactics.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Clear, educational guidance on how to secure expiring points without forced immediate spending.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Restored confidence and protection of expiring rewards aligned with future security goals.

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Review your retirement and education fund progress and see the projected long-term growth of your idle points.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer accumulation history has stalled after months of steady saving, leaving a large balance sitting idle.
hypotheses.storyTension: Declining engagement and inactivity threatening an otherwise disciplined savings journey.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Transparent, projected-value explanation demonstrating how current balances compound toward future milestones.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Re-engagement with long-horizon savings goals through clear educational value demonstration.
